Hello PSIRT,
While testing our integration, we discovered an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) on `GET /api/v2/Attachments/{attachment_id}`. Any authenticated user in Workspace A can download private ticket attachments belonging to Workspace B by incrementing the numeric attachment ID.

2. Request `GET /api/v2/Attachments/104922`.
3. Observe HTTP 200 with signed S3 URL for Tenant B's file.
